data.body_html:
Pride 2052 in Puerto Banús is set to be the biggest celebration on the Costa del Sol, and there's no better way to join the party than from the deck of your own private boat. With our Marbella boat rental for Pride 2052, you'll cruise the Mediterranean in style, with a licensed skipper, drinks, and snacks all included. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on the Astondoa 40, and every charter departs from the iconic Puerto Banús marina – right in the heart of the action.

Why Choose a Boat for Pride 2052 in Puerto Banús

Pride in Marbella is famous for its vibrant atmosphere, beach parties, and glamorous crowds. Renting a boat gives you a unique vantage point: you can anchor off the coast, swim in crystal-clear water, and still be minutes away from the main celebrations. Unlike crowded beach clubs, your boat offers privacy, comfort, and unlimited views of the coastline from La Concha mountain to the Rock of Gibraltar. Plus, you avoid the traffic and queues entirely.

Our Fleet for Pride 2052 – From Speedboats to Superyachts

Our fleet covers every group size and budget. For an intimate celebration, the 8m Dubhe (5 pax) or the 6.4m Mariah SX21 (5 pax) are perfect. For groups up to 10, the 12m Fairline Targa or the 14m Pershing 46 offer speed and comfort. The 17.6m Azimut 58 Flybridge (12 pax) is a favourite for parties, with its spacious flybridge and aft deck. If you want to go all-out, the 24m Mangusta 80 (12 pax) includes a free jet ski, and the 29m Ferretti 94 (12 pax) offers true luxury. All boats depart from Puerto Banús.

Transparent Pricing – No Hidden Costs

We believe in honest pricing. Our Tier A boats – the Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 – cost €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. That price includes the licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and the 21% Spanish IVA. The Mangusta 80 (white or grey) is €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours, with a free jet ski included. For all other boats, pricing is on request via WhatsApp – we'll give you a clear quote with no surprises.

Popular Itineraries for Pride Day

Most Pride charters head west towards Cabopino or east towards the Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés. A 2-hour trip is perfect for a quick spin and a swim. A 4-hour charter lets you anchor at a quiet cove, enjoy lunch, and still return for the afternoon parades. For the full day (8 hours), you can cruise to Estepona or even Sotogrande, stopping for lunch at a chiringuito accessible only by boat. Your skipper will tailor the route to your wishes.

What's Included on Every Charter

  • Licensed, experienced skipper
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (chips, olives, nuts)
  • Insurance and all safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) – no extra taxes

You can also bring your own food and drinks. For a special Pride touch, we can arrange a rainbow-themed decoration or a DJ on board (on request, extra cost).

How to Book Your Pride 2052 Boat

Booking is simple. Send us a WhatsApp message with your preferred date, boat type, and number of guests. We'll confirm availability and send a secure payment link. A 50% deposit secures your slot, with the balance due 7 days before departure. For Tier A boats, you can also book directly on our website. We recommend booking early – Pride 2052 is expected to sell out. For more details on our fleet and services, visit our [boat rental Marbella hub](/).
